overview_description.description: MinusX provides an AI data scientist who integrates with Metabase to analyze business data. The platform handles ad-hoc data requests and answers questions directly on dashboards. The system allows users to create and query data catalogs without redefining metrics. It operates locally on the browser, ensuring that raw data does not leave the system and meets SOC 2 and GDPR compliance. The platform offers different plans for individuals, teams, and enterprises, including support, data integrations, and advanced training services.

product.name: MinusX Chrome Extension for Metabase
product.description: A Chrome extension that integrates AI data agents into Metabase to provide accurate data analysis and answer business questions directly within the analytics platform.

product.name: Data Analyst Agent
product.description: An AI agent within MinusX that understands Metabase data structures to provide accurate answers and reduce ad-hoc data requests.

product.name: Data Engineering Agent
product.description: An AI agent that catalogs data assets to enable organizational self-sufficiency in data usage and management.

product.name: Research Agent
product.description: An AI agent that performs extensive data slicing and dicing to surface insights that users might not discover manually.

product.name: Q&A on Metabase Dashboards
product.description: A feature allowing users to ask questions and get answers directly on Metabase dashboards without switching contexts.
